newsitem.title: USA: BankBoston gets approval for joint venture.
newsitem.headline: BankBoston gets approval for joint venture.

text.p: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency has approved a joint venture between BankBoston Corp and a consulting firm to offer life insurance funded, executive benefit consulting, BankBoston said Thursday.

The bank said in a statement the venture with William J. Lynch and Associates, called BancBoston Executive Benefits LLC, would serve corporation that need death and retirement benefits for senior corporate executives.
It said it would provide the same services to private bank customers who want the same benefits.
BankBoston specializes in consumer banking with assets of $64.8 billion.
